product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill provides Jack, an AI career agent that finds and introduces job seekers to suitable roles, and Jill, an AI hiring agent that helps companies find and hire candidates.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its two agents as serving job seekers and hiring companies.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists free options and paid company plans.

named_customers.notes: These names are shown on Jack & Jill’s Customer Stories page.

employee_band.notes: The company’s about page states that the team has 28 people.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom identifies London, United Kingdom as headquarters; Jack & Jill’s about page also identifies London as one of its team locations.

founded_year.notes: The article reports that Jack & Jill was founded in March 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes product and industry content, but does not show at least two technical posts about how the product is built by engineers. The identified technical AI-sourcing post is by CEO Matthew Wilson, not an engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public docs site has multiple product and integration articles, including getting started, candidate discovery, FAQs, ATS integrations, and Slack integration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists roles including Founding Engineer and Account Executive, but no role title matching the specified AI, ML, or data-science categories.

model_provider.notes: The product documentation, terms, blog, and surfaced privacy/security materials refer to AI or language models generically but do not publicly name a model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The assurance page describes third-party AI audits and related regulatory frameworks, but does not name any of the requested certifications: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The funding announcement reports a $40 million Series A announced September 15, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced September 15, 2026, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board includes open Account Executive positions in San Francisco and London.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced that its Company Insights feature was live on November 4, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company’s small team page lists the founders and team but shows no C-level or VP-level join within the past 12 months; no departure announcement was found there.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable documentation lists ATS and team-workflow integrations such as Ashby, Workable, BambooHR, and Slack, but names no CRM or sales/marketing system.
